author: ETA PRIME
description:
This all-new modular mini PC from Khadas isn't just a mini PC — with a quick flip and a snap, the Mind X Play transforms the Mind Pro into a full-fledged laptop. Powered by Intel's Panther Lake Core Ultra X7 358H with 64GB of RAM and Arc B350 graphics, this thing packs serious performance in a portable package. The Mind X Play adds a stunning 13" IPS display (2880x1920, 3:2 aspect ratio, 500 nits, 100% DCI-P3), a 47.94Wh battery, detachable keyboard with trackpad, dual stereo speakers, a camera, and extra I/O — all connected through the ultra-fast Mind Link port running PCIe 5.0 x4 speeds. I tested battery life, gaming performance, everyday multitasking, and even used it as an external monitor for Samsung DeX and handhelds like the Steam Deck. Here's everything you need to know. What do you think — would you use a modular mini PC as your daily laptop? Let me know in the comments!
